item.title: The Last Time I Rewound: VHS, Star Wars, and the Freedom to Remember
item.description: I can’t exactly recall when I watched my last movie on VHS, but the cassette tape once defined my childhood. For kids of the 1980s and 1990s, videotapes were currency—expensive objects that you treasured, rewound, and wore out.
